artifacts.summary: 10-phase, 13.5-hour implementation plan repairing the top-level README.md and the FormalSystem/**/README.md layer across 17 files in 9 disjoint territories, with 5 pre-declared decisions and a shared source-verified ground-truth table.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan splits a documentation-correction pass across many files that must converge on the SAME figures (axiom counts, class enumerations, layer tables), put those figures in a 'Shared ground truth' section of the plan itself, with a .lean citation per row, rather than leaving them only in the research report. The observed failure mode in a multi-README layer is two documents disagreeing; disjoint file territories make phases parallelizable but do NOT prevent semantic divergence, because each phase transcribes independently. The plan-level shared table plus a final cross-file grep sweep in the gate phase closes that gap. Pair it with a per-phase 'Scope Hypothesis' naming the source-side command (grep/wc -l/find) that re-confirms that phase's own subset at implementation time, so no figure is ever copied from another markdown document.
